resources.string: Provides bounded accessibility snapshots and local supported actions while you have enabled this service in Android accessibility settings. Authenticated host transport is not implemented yet. AndroidUse does not bypass lock screens, authentication, secure windows, or app protections. Password values are redacted. Stop it at any time in the app or by turning off the service in Android settings.
Shown while AndroidUse remote control is enabled.
Remote control is on. An approved host can connect once pairing and transport are configured. Open AndroidUse to stop.
